# What should Good, Better and Best repair options cost on this HVAC call?

> True cost per hour, a diagnostic fee, three repair prices with tiered parts markup and what an average call earns at your mix. Your numbers, not advice. No account, no upload.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
